title: Homesite Reservation Hold Expiry and Reinstatement Terms
content:
## Expiry

A held homesite under a Homesite Reservation lapses at the end of its hold expiry date, and the system marks it expired the next day. A courtesy expiry reminder is sent the class's expiry reminder days before the hold expiry date.

## Reinstatement

1. An expired hold may be reinstated on the same homesite at most the class's maximum reinstatements per reservation. The words "on payment of the class's reinstatement fee as a reinstatement fee component" in that clause are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis for the reinstatement fee charged.
2. Reinstatement must be requested within the class's reinstatement window days after the date the hold expired. Counting starts the day after the expiry date, and the last counted day is included. The date the hold expired is the end date shown on that expired reservation's record.
3. The clause "a reinstated hold runs the class's extension days from the reinstatement date" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the reinstated hold term.

## When the reinstatement window closes without reinstatement

Where the class refunds funds on an expired hold automatically once the reinstatement window closes, the reservation deposit is refunded with the reason hold expired; the premium holding fee is retained where the class retains it on expiry and is otherwise refunded; every fee component is retained.

## Window boundary (hypothetical window of 2 days, hold expired on 5 August)

| Day of the request | Day count | Inside the window |
|---|---|---|
| 6 August | day 1 | Yes |
| 7 August | day 2, the last counted day | Yes |
| 8 August | day 3 | No |

## Settlement at window close (hypothetical class that refunds automatically)

| Class retains the premium holding fee on expiry | Reservation deposit | Premium holding fee | Fee components |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | refunded, reason hold expired | retained | retained |
| No | refunded, reason hold expired | refunded | retained |
